{
  "name": "jev-rules",
  "displayName": "jev-rules",
  "version": "0.5.0",
  "description": "Jev picks which of your rules apply to each prompt, so Claude only sees the ones that matter.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Elia Alberti",
    "url": "https://github.com/EliaAlberti"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/EliaAlberti/jev-rules",
  "repository": "https://github.com/EliaAlberti/jev-rules",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "rules",
    "context",
    "hooks",
    "jev",
    "typesafe",
    "conventions",
    "pane"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "show_picks": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Show Jev's picks",
      "description": "on shows one line under each prompt, and before an edit that brings a rule, naming what Claude was given and Jev's score for each. off keeps the conversation as it was.",
      "options": [
        "on",
        "off"
      ],
      "default": "on"
    },
    "pane_opens": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Rules pane opens",
      "description": "Applies once the rules pane is switched on (/jev-rules:pane, or CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1 in the env block of ~/.claude/settings.json). on-first-pick opens the rules pane by itself the first time Jev picks a rule in a session, when the window is wide enough to show it beside the conversation. only-with-command waits for /rules.",
      "options": [
        "on-first-pick",
        "only-with-command"
      ],
      "default": "on-first-pick"
    }
  }
}
